answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, forfeited on duplicate submission. The orchard of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The meadow lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the cipher is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
